meta.title: Ill Tidings
meta.description: Grim reports all too often follow on the heels of good news.

units.rawText: When we open our eyes again, we're back at the beginning.
units.displayText: When we open our eyes again, we're back at the beginning.

spans.text: When we open our eyes again, we're back at the beginning.

units.rawText: However, this time we're not at the place where we contacted Croque, but at Choco's Chocolaterie.
units.displayText: However, this time we're not at the place where we contacted Croque, but at Choco's Chocolaterie.

spans.text: However, this time we're not at the place where we contacted Croque, but at Choco's Chocolaterie.

units.rawText: Is everyone alright? Huh... why did we end up back here?
units.displayText: Is everyone alright? Huh... why did we end up back here?

spans.text: Is everyone alright? Huh... why did we end up back here?

units.rawText: How did this happen? Why was there still an explosion?
units.displayText: How did this happen? Why was there still an explosion?

spans.text: How did this happen? Why was there still an explosion?

units.rawText: We fixed Reactor No. 1. There's no way anything could have gone wrong with my technical skills!
units.displayText: We fixed Reactor No. 1. There's no way anything could have gone wrong with my technical skills!

spans.text: We fixed Reactor No. 1. There's no way anything could have gone wrong with my technical skills!

units.rawText: Calm down, Croque. This isn't your fault. I believe in your skills.
units.displayText: Calm down, Croque. This isn't your fault. I believe in your skills.

spans.text: Calm down, Croque. This isn't your fault. I believe in your skills.

units.rawText: The explosion... wasn't from... Reactor No. 1...
units.displayText: The explosion... wasn't from... Reactor No. 1...

spans.text: The explosion... wasn't from... Reactor No. 1...

units.rawText: Zion's answer makes us all sink into silence. This sudden development was far too unexpected, so we need time to sort our thoughts out.
units.displayText: Zion's answer makes us all sink into silence. This sudden development was far too unexpected, so we need time to sort our thoughts out.

units.rawText: Hm—hmhm—hm—
units.displayText: Hm—hmhm—hm—

spans.text: Hm—hmhm—hm—

units.rawText: Munchmunchmunch—
units.displayText: Munchmunchmunch—

spans.text: Munchmunchmunch—

units.rawText: A strange sound comes from a corner of the room, made especially obvious since everyone has gone quiet.
units.displayText: A strange sound comes from a corner of the room, made especially obvious since everyone has gone quiet.

spans.text: A strange sound comes from a corner of the room, made especially obvious since everyone has gone quiet.

units.rawText: Little... Little E?
units.displayText: Little... Little E?

spans.text: Little... Little E?

units.rawText: Oh— You're back? That was fast.
units.displayText: Oh— You're back? That was fast.

spans.text: Oh— You're back? That was fast.

units.rawText: Ah, this is great! Choco, your chocolate is delicious! Do you have more?
units.displayText: Ah, this is great! Choco, your chocolate is delicious! Do you have more?

spans.text: Ah, this is great! Choco, your chocolate is delicious! Do you have more?

units.rawText: I'll have you know that I didn't eat anything since yesterday just to eat your chocolate. I'm starving.
units.displayText: I'll have you know that I didn't eat anything since yesterday just to eat your chocolate. I'm starving.

spans.text: I'll have you know that I didn't eat anything since yesterday just to eat your chocolate. I'm starving.

units.rawText: Eh?! That's no good! You can't let yourself go hungry! Choco will make more for you right now.
units.displayText: Eh?! That's no good! You can't let yourself go hungry! Choco will make more for you right now.

spans.text: Eh?! That's no good! You can't let yourself go hungry! Choco will make more for you right now.

units.rawText: Wait! Don't go over!
units.displayText: Wait! Don't go over!

spans.text: Wait! Don't go over!

units.rawText: Sol steps out in front of Choco, while also surreptitiously drawing her weapons.
units.displayText: Sol steps out in front of Choco, while also surreptitiously drawing her weapons.

spans.text: Sol steps out in front of Choco, while also surreptitiously drawing her weapons.

units.rawText: Honestly, can't it wait until after I've eaten?
units.displayText: Honestly, can't it wait until after I've eaten?

spans.text: Honestly, can't it wait until after I've eaten?

units.rawText: Meals are sacred things, you know. Everything else comes second to them.
units.displayText: Meals are sacred things, you know. Everything else comes second to them.

spans.text: Meals are sacred things, you know. Everything else comes second to them.

units.rawText: You have a point... no, wait! Why the hell did you show up here, anyway?
units.displayText: You have a point... no, wait! Why the hell did you show up here, anyway?

spans.text: You have a point... no, wait! Why the hell did you show up here, anyway?

units.rawText: Also, there's what you said before... Are YOU the one who trapped us here?!
units.displayText: Also, there's what you said before... Are YOU the one who trapped us here?!

spans.text: Also, there's what you said before... Are YOU the one who trapped us here?!

units.rawText: Hey! Don't go pinning stuff on me, I had nothing to do with the explosion!
units.displayText: Hey! Don't go pinning stuff on me, I had nothing to do with the explosion!

spans.text: Hey! Don't go pinning stuff on me, I had nothing to do with the explosion!

units.rawText: What are you going to do if Choco gets the wrong idea because of what you said and stops making chocolate for me? This is one of the few small pleasures I have in life besides my work.
units.displayText: What are you going to do if Choco gets the wrong idea because of what you said and stops making chocolate for me? This is one of the few small pleasures I have in life besides my work.

spans.text: What are you going to do if Choco gets the wrong idea because of what you said and stops making chocolate for me? This is one of the few small pleasures I have in life besides my work.

units.rawText: As a Sanctifier, I run all over Magrasea every day and stress myself out, with this little piece of chocolate as my only solace. Are you going to take even that little bit of happiness away from me? You really are evil.
units.displayText: As a Sanctifier, I run all over Magrasea every day and stress myself out, with this little piece of chocolate as my only solace. Are you going to take even that little bit of happiness away from me? You really are evil.

spans.text: As a Sanctifier, I run all over Magrasea every day and stress myself out, with this little piece of chocolate as my only solace. Are you going to take even that little bit of happiness away from me? You really are evil.

units.rawText: Don't change the topic. What on earth is going on?
units.displayText: Don't change the topic. What on earth is going on?

spans.text: Don't change the topic. What on earth is going on?

units.rawText: And why should I tell you? Aren't you lot the Irregular Agents that the other Sanctifiers mentioned before?
units.displayText: And why should I tell you? Aren't you lot the Irregular Agents that the other Sanctifiers mentioned before?

spans.text: And why should I tell you? Aren't you lot the Irregular Agents that the other Sanctifiers mentioned before?

units.rawText: You built the Oasis, stole access permissions from other sectors... I mean, not that I really mind, but our situation makes us enemies, right?
units.displayText: You built the Oasis, stole access permissions from other sectors... I mean, not that I really mind, but our situation makes us enemies, right?

spans.text: You built the Oasis, stole access permissions from other sectors... I mean, not that I really mind, but our situation makes us enemies, right?

units.rawText: Since we're enemies, it's not like I owe you anything, so why should I answer your questions?
units.displayText: Since we're enemies, it's not like I owe you anything, so why should I answer your questions?

spans.text: Since we're enemies, it's not like I owe you anything, so why should I answer your questions?

units.rawText: Little E... ate... lots... of chocolate...
units.displayText: Little E... ate... lots... of chocolate...

spans.text: Little E... ate... lots... of chocolate...

units.rawText: Er... Does eating chocolate even count?!
units.displayText: Er... Does eating chocolate even count?!

spans.text: Er... Does eating chocolate even count?!

units.rawText: Also, don't forget that I provided you with the ingredient for the Memory Chocolate, "Reset Exemption"!
units.displayText: Also, don't forget that I provided you with the ingredient for the Memory Chocolate, "Reset Exemption"!

spans.text: Also, don't forget that I provided you with the ingredient for the Memory Chocolate, "Reset Exemption"!

units.rawText: Little E, I came up with a new recipe for chocolate today...
units.displayText: Little E, I came up with a new recipe for chocolate today...

spans.text: Little E, I came up with a new recipe for chocolate today...

units.rawText: Ahem. Well, though we might be enemies, I AM quite interested in you guys, so I don't mind revealing a bit of information to you.
units.displayText: Ahem. Well, though we might be enemies, I AM quite interested in you guys, so I don't mind revealing a bit of information to you.

spans.text: Ahem. Well, though we might be enemies, I AM quite interested in you guys, so I don't mind revealing a bit of information to you.

units.rawText: Ah, Choco, go make your chocolate first, I'll have a nice chat with your friends.
units.displayText: Ah, Choco, go make your chocolate first, I'll have a nice chat with your friends.

spans.text: Ah, Choco, go make your chocolate first, I'll have a nice chat with your friends.

units.rawText: I exchange looks with Persicaria, and we make room for Eucharist.
units.displayText: I exchange looks with Persicaria, and we make room for Eucharist.

spans.text: I exchange looks with Persicaria, and we make room for Eucharist.

units.rawText: Let me ask you a few simple questions. Do you know what they do here in the Helios Sector?
units.displayText: Let me ask you a few simple questions. Do you know what they do here in the Helios Sector?

spans.text: Let me ask you a few simple questions. Do you know what they do here in the Helios Sector?

units.rawText: It's a Svarog Heavy Industries experimental energy research sector, responsible for many revolutionary experiments in the field of energy.
units.displayText: It's a Svarog Heavy Industries experimental energy research sector, responsible for many revolutionary experiments in the field of energy.

spans.text: It's a Svarog Heavy Industries experimental energy research sector, responsible for many revolutionary experiments in the field of energy.

units.rawText: Correct... but not entirely. Helios Sector is only responsible for one experiment, which is the "Arche Pyr" Project.
units.displayText: Correct... but not entirely. Helios Sector is only responsible for one experiment, which is the "Arche Pyr" Project.

spans.text: Correct... but not entirely. Helios Sector is only responsible for one experiment, which is the "Arche Pyr" Project.

units.rawText: The Arche Pyr... So you're saying the seven reactors were built for the Arche Pyr?
units.displayText: The Arche Pyr... So you're saying the seven reactors were built for the Arche Pyr?

spans.text: The Arche Pyr... So you're saying the seven reactors were built for the Arche Pyr?

units.rawText: No wonder I couldn't find any logs for the Arche Pyr in all the places I looked. Turns out the entire sector WAS the Arche Pyr.
units.displayText: No wonder I couldn't find any logs for the Arche Pyr in all the places I looked. Turns out the entire sector WAS the Arche Pyr.

spans.text: No wonder I couldn't find any logs for the Arche Pyr in all the places I looked. Turns out the entire sector WAS the Arche Pyr.

units.rawText: Correct, so do you understand what I was talking about just now?
units.displayText: Correct, so do you understand what I was talking about just now?

spans.text: Correct, so do you understand what I was talking about just now?

units.rawText: You don't really think that Reactor No.1 was the only problematic area in Helios Sector, do you?
units.displayText: You don't really think that Reactor No.1 was the only problematic area in Helios Sector, do you?

spans.text: You don't really think that Reactor No.1 was the only problematic area in Helios Sector, do you?

units.rawText: An ordinary agent like you...
units.displayText: An ordinary agent like you...

spans.text: An ordinary agent like you...

units.rawText: I'm a mechanical expert.
units.displayText: I'm a mechanical expert.

spans.text: I'm a mechanical expert.

units.rawText: Fine, fine, you're a mechanical expert.
units.displayText: Fine, fine, you're a mechanical expert.

spans.text: Fine, fine, you're a mechanical expert.

units.rawText: But if a lone mechanical expert like you could solve the problems with the Arche Pyr Project, what point would there be in the existence of the Helios Sector?
units.displayText: But if a lone mechanical expert like you could solve the problems with the Arche Pyr Project, what point would there be in the existence of the Helios Sector?

spans.text: But if a lone mechanical expert like you could solve the problems with the Arche Pyr Project, what point would there be in the existence of the Helios Sector?

units.rawText: Are you saying the entire sector is less capable than you alone?
units.displayText: Are you saying the entire sector is less capable than you alone?

spans.text: Are you saying the entire sector is less capable than you alone?

units.rawText: Then what's the deal with the resets?
units.displayText: Then what's the deal with the resets?

spans.text: Then what's the deal with the resets?

units.rawText: The resets? That's something else entirely!
units.displayText: The resets? That's something else entirely!

spans.text: The resets? That's something else entirely!

units.rawText: Choco! Is the chocolate done yet?
units.displayText: Choco! Is the chocolate done yet?

spans.text: Choco! Is the chocolate done yet?

units.rawText: It's finished! Here, this is what Choco made today with the new recipe.
units.displayText: It's finished! Here, this is what Choco made today with the new recipe.

spans.text: It's finished! Here, this is what Choco made today with the new recipe.

units.rawText: Mm, smells great!
units.displayText: Mm, smells great!

spans.text: Mm, smells great!

units.rawText: Hm? Why are you guys still looking at me?
units.displayText: Hm? Why are you guys still looking at me?

spans.text: Hm? Why are you guys still looking at me?

units.rawText: I really can't tell you about the resets. Why don't you ask the Sector Administrator about it?
units.displayText: I really can't tell you about the resets. Why don't you ask the Sector Administrator about it?

spans.text: I really can't tell you about the resets. Why don't you ask the Sector Administrator about it?

units.rawText: You're saying... The administrator knows everything about this?
units.displayText: You're saying... The administrator knows everything about this?

spans.text: You're saying... The administrator knows everything about this?

units.rawText: Of course... Oh! I get it, you think the resets are an error in the sector, do you?
units.displayText: Of course... Oh! I get it, you think the resets are an error in the sector, do you?

spans.text: Of course... Oh! I get it, you think the resets are an error in the sector, do you?

units.rawText: Hahahaha, of course not. If the resets were caused by a sector error or a virus, I'd have stepped in long ago.
units.displayText: Hahahaha, of course not. If the resets were caused by a sector error or a virus, I'd have stepped in long ago.

spans.text: Hahahaha, of course not. If the resets were caused by a sector error or a virus, I'd have stepped in long ago.

units.rawText: I may not look like it, but I'm a Greater Sanctifier, you know.
units.displayText: I may not look like it, but I'm a Greater Sanctifier, you know.

spans.text: I may not look like it, but I'm a Greater Sanctifier, you know.

units.rawText: All right, that's enough idle chatter. Thanks for the hospitality. I'll be off now. Choco, pack some more chocolate for me~
units.displayText: All right, that's enough idle chatter. Thanks for the hospitality. I'll be off now. Choco, pack some more chocolate for me~

units.displayText: One last question, please. Why aren't you fighting us?

spans.text: One last question, please. Why aren't you fighting us?

units.rawText: Ah, I know you, Professor. The leader of the Irregular Agents. I'm VERY interested in you as well~
units.displayText: Ah, I know you, Professor. The leader of the Irregular Agents. I'm VERY interested in you as well~

spans.text: Ah, I know you, Professor. The leader of the Irregular Agents. I'm VERY interested in you as well~

units.rawText: As for your question... I told you before, right? Because there's no need to.
units.displayText: As for your question... I told you before, right? Because there's no need to.

spans.text: As for your question... I told you before, right? Because there's no need to.

units.rawText: For Choco's sake, I'll give you a bit of advice; you'd better move quickly, or else... Hehe.
